items.name: types
items.title: Types
items.description: Core TypeScript type definitions for the design canvas — element types, camera, tools, panels, hit testing, and interaction state.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: math
items.title: Math
items.description: Geometry helpers — rotate point, bounds checking, ellipse hit test, screen/world coordinate conversion, normalize bounds, distance, and clamping.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: id
items.title: ID
items.description: ID generation utility using crypto.randomUUID.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: color
items.title: Color
items.description: OKLCh color parsing and manipulation utilities — parse, serialize, and adjust lightness.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: document-store
items.title: Document Store
items.description: Zustand store for canvas document state — elements, camera, selection, and undo/redo history with colocated actions.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: tool-store
items.title: Tool Store
items.description: Zustand store for active tool state with temporary tool support (e.g. hold Space for hand tool).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: panel-store
items.title: Panel Store
items.description: Zustand store for panel visibility — left panel, right panel, and open/collapse state.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: element-factory
items.title: Element Factory
items.description: Factory functions for creating design elements — rectangle, ellipse, text, line, and frame with sensible defaults.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: renderer
items.title: Renderer
items.description: Pure Canvas 2D rendering functions — grid, elements (rectangle, ellipse, text, line, frame), selection boxes, resize handles, creation preview, and marquee.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: hit-test
items.title: Hit Test
items.description: Pure geometry functions for point-in-element testing, element-at-point lookup, marquee selection, and resize handle detection.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-drag
items.title: useCanvasDrag
items.description: Hook for managing drag state machine — tracks drag type (create, move, resize, marquee, pan), start/current positions, and element snapshots.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-transform
items.title: useCanvasTransform
items.description: Hook for screen/world coordinate conversion, pan, zoom-to-point, zoom in/out, and reset zoom.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-hit-test
items.title: useHitTest
items.description: Hook wrapping hit-test functions with canvas state — get element or resize handle at screen point.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-renderer
items.title: useCanvasRenderer
items.description: Hook for the requestAnimationFrame render loop — dirty-flag optimization, DPR-aware canvas sizing, and full render pipeline (grid, elements, selection UI, creation preview, marquee).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-interaction
items.title: useCanvasInteraction
items.description: Hook for pointer event handling — state machine for idle, panning, creating, moving, resizing, and marquee selecting. Handles element creation, selection, and drag operations.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: useKeyboardShortcuts
items.description: Hook for global keyboard shortcuts — tool switching (V/R/O/T/F), delete, undo/redo, select all, duplicate, zoom, and temporary hand tool (Space hold).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: design-canvas
items.title: Design Canvas
items.description: The main canvas component — renders a full-size HTML5 Canvas element with cursor management, pointer events, and keyboard shortcuts wired up.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Floating toolbar with toggle groups, toggle buttons with tooltips, separators, and dropdown menus for tool variant selection. Built directly on Radix primitives.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: Side panel container with position (left/right), variant (tool/default), border, and scroll area. Used for layers, properties, and other side panels.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: pane
items.title: Pane
items.description: Content section within a panel — Pane wrapper with PaneHeader, PaneLabel, and PaneAction for composing property editors.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: action
items.title: Action
items.description: Form field row layout — Action container with ActionLabel and ActionControls for consistent label + control rows in property panes.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider component built directly on Radix Slider primitive with design tool styling.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: Container component for creative surfaces — provides consistent mount point with canvas background, optional overlay controls, and dot grid background.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: easing
items.title: Easing
items.description: Cubic bezier easing utilities — presets, evaluation via Newton's method, CSS cubic-bezier() parsing and serialisation.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: animation-store
items.title: Animation Store
items.description: Zustand store for animation playback — duration, current time, play/pause, zoom level, and keyframe selection.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Compound timeline component with ruler, playhead, tracks, keyframe diamonds, and transport controls for animation and sequencing tools.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

meta.example: <Timeline><TimelineTransport /><TimelineRuler duration={5} zoomLevel={100} /><TimelineTrack label="opacity"><TimelineKeyframe time={0} duration={5} zoomLevel={100} /><TimelineKeyframe time={2.5} duration={5} zoomLevel={100} /></TimelineTrack></Timeline>

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: Responsive thumbnail grid with selection state, hover overlays, and action buttons. Used for image histories, asset browsers, and media galleries.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: colour-picker
items.title: Colour Picker
items.description: Colour picker with hex input and swatch preview, powered by react-colorful in a Radix Popover. Used in material editors, fill/stroke controls, and chart styling.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: easing-curve-editor
items.title: Easing Curve Editor
items.description: Interactive cubic bezier curve editor with draggable control points and preset buttons. Used for keyframe easing in animation tools.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

meta.example: <EasingCurveEditor value={{ x1: 0.42, y1: 0, x2: 0.58, y2: 1 }} onChange={setEasing} />
